titulo: From... to...: de... a and desde... hasta
subtitulo: De lunes a viernes, desde las ocho hasta las cinco.
regla: To say from... to... in time or space, use the pair de... a or the pair desde... hasta. Keep the pairs together. Desde... hasta is a bit more emphatic about the start and end points.

bloques.texto: Spanish has two pairs for _from... to..._ They work for **time** and for **places**.
**De... a** is the everyday, neutral pair. **Desde... hasta** stresses the starting and finishing points: _all the way from... all the way to..._
Don't mix the pairs: **desde... a** is wrong, and **de... hasta**, though you'll hear it, sounds sloppy. Keep each pair together.
Remember the contractions: **de + el = del**, **a + el = al**: _**del** centro **al** malecón_.

With hours, both pairs can take the article: _de **las** ocho a **las** diez_, _desde **las** ocho hasta **las** diez_. With days, **de lunes a viernes** has no article; **desde el lunes hasta el viernes** does.
Each word also works alone: **desde** = _since, from_; **hasta** = _until, as far as_: _Te espero **hasta** las seis._

lista.en: The store is open from Monday to Saturday.
I have class from seven to nine.
We walked all the way from the beach to the lighthouse.
It rained from Friday all the way to Sunday.
How long does it take from Tijuana to Ensenada?
We biked from downtown to the boardwalk.

lista.es: La línea estuvo llena ==desde== las cinco ==hasta== las diez.
lista.en: The border line was packed from five until ten.
I water the garden from May to October.

filas.t: Fuimos de el centro a el mercado.
